name: Aster Medcity
summary: Aster Medcity is a multispecialty hospital at Cheranelloor in Kochi, part of the Aster hospital group and open since 2013. It runs centres of excellence in cardiac sciences, neurosciences, oncology, orthopaedics and multi-organ transplant, with an international patient service.
highlights: Awarded Joint Commission International (JCI) accreditation in July 2015, the first quaternary care hospital in Kerala to hold it, per the hospital
Also accredited by NABH, India's national hospital accreditation board
Centres of excellence in cardiac sciences, neurosciences, oncology, orthopaedics, gastro sciences and multi-organ transplant
